modes.label: Core monthly list
modes.note: Estimator-only encoding: sizes.hour and month_cap both equal full monthly rent, with a one-hour synthetic minimum. This is NOT a vendor hourly tariff. For valid workloads with sessions >= peak concurrency it charges one monthly rental per concurrent machine, including off-hours. Setup/term cash outlays are caveated separately.

modes.commit_note: Advertised effective monthly rate for the first 24 months of a 24-month subscription; regular list price is crossed out.

modes.commit_note: Missing product family; no snapshots, Auto Backup, or Storage Extension.

plans.name: Usage account
plans.note: Account quotas and stock availability must be checked before deploying 50 concurrent machines; no quota approval implied.

caveats: DIY infrastructure rather than an agent-managed sandbox: guest installation, HTTPS/domain setup, abuse controls and operations are customer responsibilities. Linux guest administrative capabilities are not preinstalled agent features. 30% guest CPU utilization does not reduce allocated-compute charges. Unknowns remain null; a partial subtotal is not a complete invoice.
Core Cloud VPS 4 is 4vCPU/8GB/100GB SSD at native catalog $6.60/month before term discounts/location extras. Old Cloud VPS 10 product price/specs are not substituted.
Current family traffic is unlimited subject to fair use, throttling on disruptive usage. Old 32TB allowance documents are superseded for current catalog.
One IPv4 and IPv6 subnet included. Region surcharges, paid images, Auto Backup and add-on storage are additional.
The 8vCPU Core configurator shows no setup fee on inspected term options; other product/term setup remains null rather than generalized free.

Shared vCPU (Cloud VPS / VPS Plus): Contabo does not publish a CPU guarantee for these tiers; oversold vCPU can see steal under sustained load. Only Cloud VDS gives dedicated physical cores. Encoded as cpu_class shared (not burstable: no published baseline).

Monthly billing only (contabo.com/en-us/vps, 2026-09-28): minimum 1-month prepaid term, no hourly billing, and no per-session create/delete API economics; servers are provisioned "in minutes" after payment clears. The estimate prices whole monthly rentals; bursty workloads must keep machines rented.

Snapshots: Cloud VPS 4 includes 1 snapshot slot, VPS 6 2, VPS 8-18 3, VPS Plus 5 (catalog); VDS none listed. No per-GiB price for retained snapshots or extra slots is published, so snapshot_gib_month is null (was 0).

Setup fee: the product catalog flags a setup fee as displayed for 1-month terms (oneMonthSetupFeeDisplaySettings) but no amount is published in the catalog or on the VPS page; left unpriced (unknown, not zero).
Boot time not measured; boot_overhead_s unset.
VPS Auto Backup (paid add-on, Core and Performance VPS only; not Storage VPS, VDS, GPU VPS or dedicated): daily, up to 10 backups kept for at most 10 days; price not captured.

fleet.verification: Customer-data verification; manual review may request passport, driving licence or national identity card.
fleet.notes: Order-verification documentation supplies no universal new-account VPS/server count or quota-increase schedule. Ordering many servers is subject to verification and provisioning availability, not proven unlimited.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: Schedule: one backup per day, incremental after the initial full backup, with at least 8 hours between backups.
snapshot_auto.note: Plain monthly-rented KVM VPS; nothing is saved on stop (disk simply persists). The only automatic mechanism is the paid Auto Backup add-on (Core/Performance VPS): daily off-server incremental backups, up to 10 kept for 10 days, whole-VPS restore in place. Not a stop/idle snapshot.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: Snapshots	Image of the VPS disk, retained for 30 days; slots per family as in Products at a Glance
snapshot_on_demand.note: Disk only, no memory. Create/list/update/delete/rollback via Control Panel, API (POST /v1/compute/instances/{id}/snapshots, .../rollback) and cntb CLI. Slots: Cloud VPS 4: 1, VPS 6: 2, VPS 8-18: 3, VPS Plus: 5; Storage VPS none; VDS/dedicated none listed. Restore is an in-place rollback of the same instance; no documented create-instance-from-snapshot (custom images come from a URL).

harness_api.note: Plain VPS; the API/CLI/Terraform only manage instances, images, snapshots, networks, firewalls and object storage. No agent harness integration.

egress_allowlist.quote: Default policy: all inbound traffic is dropped by a permanent default rule; outbound traffic is unrestricted.
egress_allowlist.note: The API spec also says: 'Currently only inbound rules are allowed to be configured.' Egress filtering only possible with an in-guest firewall.

egress_http_rules.quote: Default policy: all inbound traffic is dropped by a permanent default rule; outbound traffic is unrestricted.
egress_http_rules.note: No provider-side outbound controls at any level.

ingress_rules.quote: A firewall is attached to one or more instances; rules take effect immediately.
ingress_rules.note: Network-level Contabo Firewall for VPS/VDS/GPU VPS: default-drop inbound once activated, allow rules by TCP/UDP/ICMP, source IP/CIDR (v4/v6), port/list/range; managed via Control Panel, API, CLI. Docs page says 'Included' but the API spec says each protected instance 'requires a paid firewall add-on' (conflict). Not available for dedicated servers; does not cover private networks. Each VPS has a public IPv4 + /64 IPv6, all ports open unless a firewall is attached.

guest_firewall.quote: Private networks are not covered — use the OS firewall inside a private network.
guest_firewall.note: KVM VMs with root; Contabo explicitly directs customers to the in-OS firewall (also for dedicated servers).

secret_proxy.note: Plain VPS; no credential-injection proxy or secret store documented. Secrets live wherever you put them on the VM (cloud-init user data, files).

volume_attach.quote: Storage Extension: adds storage of the plan’s type (Core VPS and Performance VPS only).
volume_attach.note: Paid Storage Extension add-on (an additional SSD/NVMe tied to the instance; 'Instances with an additional SSD cannot be region-migrated'). Not a detachable/movable block volume; not for Storage VPS. Separate S3-compatible Object Storage product.

volume_shared.quote: Object Storage is accessed entirely via the S3 API or a web UI
volume_shared.note: No shared/network filesystem product; Object Storage is S3 API only (no first-party mount). Private Networking (L2 between VPS/VDS in a region) lets you run your own NFS.
